overall_reason: The update (etcd-raft joint consensus / ConfChangeV2, confchange.Changer, RawNode-based node loop, raft.advance auto-leave) changes the configuration representation from a single voter set to a joint config (incoming voters, outgoing voters, learners, learnersNext, autoLeave) and changes single-change semantics (AddLearner on a voter now demotes; a change that leaves zero incoming voters is refused by panic; removing an unknown peer is a no-op). The standard Raft safety controls are unchanged. Every property that reads config.voters or ConfigOf must be migrated to the joint representation. Some of these migrations are pure representation changes. Others make the old text too weak (QuorumAccounting and ConfigurationTransitionSafety only look at incoming voters) or too strong (CampaignContract, TransferContract, ProposalContract and ReadBasis exclude outgoing-only voters). EffectContract needs real semantic changes. Two properties must be added: one for transition shape/quorum overlap, and one for the pending-config discipline, because auto-leave appends conf entries outside stepLeader. The new code appears to violate several still-required properties: Hup ignores V2 entries, auto-leave does not bump pendingConfIndex, and restore/newRaft drop the joint half of the ConfState. These are reported as defects, not used to weaken the properties. Executed evidence (TLC on the actual old/proposed definitions, plus Go observations of old and new code) confirmed every semantic edit and every addition. It also confirmed three defects in the new code: (1) Hup ignores EntryConfChangeV2; (2) the auto-leave is appended twice and the second panics on apply; (3) restore/newRaft drop NodesJoint/AutoLeave. No property is weakened to accommodate them. No decision changed; one witness control and the QuorumAccounting rationale were refined.

suspected_defects.text: numOfPendingConf (raft.go:1580-1588) counts only EntryConfChange. With a committed, unapplied EntryConfChangeV2 the node campaigns (Go: StateCandidate term 2, MsgVote to 2 and 3), while the V1 counterpart is blocked. This violates CampaignContract.

raft.advance auto-leave (raft.go:561-580) sets pendingConfIndex only when appendEntry fails. After a successful append, a later Advance with applied >= pendingConfIndex (paginated committed entries, MaxCommittedSizePerReady=1) appends a second leave (V2 entries at 2, 4, 5). Applying it panics "can't leave a non-joint config". This violates PendingConfigurationDiscipline, EffectContract and NoUnexpectedFatal (and ConfigurationTransitionSafety when L and L' commit together).

raft.restore (raft.go:1385-1423) and newRaft (raft.go:330-363) rebuild the config from ConfState.Nodes/Learners only: NodesJoint, LearnersNext and AutoLeave are dropped (Go: voters=(1 2 4)). An outgoing-only node rejects the snapshot (ok=false). This violates ConfigurationOrigin, and any later commit under the truncated config violates ConfigurationTransitionSafety/QuorumAccounting.

No leader-side validation of conf proposals. Leave-joint when not joint, enter-joint when joint, a V1/simple change in joint, and zero voters are all committed and then panic on every node at apply time (applyConfChange TODO). NoUnexpectedFatal flags this.
